Our point of view

Your home deserves proper attention.

For most of us, a home is much more than a place to live. It is where children grow up, families spend time together and people plan for the future. It is also one of life's most significant investments.

Keeping a property in good order can be difficult when life is busy. Small issues are easy to postpone; maintenance requests can be unclear; and a repair can involve an occupant, a property manager, access arrangements and an approval process. Ellis Services Group exists to make that first step more straightforward.

We ask customers to describe what they can see, hear or notice. They do not need to diagnose the cause before getting in touch.

Core services

Plumbing Repairs, Electrical Repairs and Property Maintenance

Ellis Services Group is part of the Ellis Group, with a dedicated local repair team and an actual office at 140 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 6000. We serve homeowners, rental homes, strata properties and property managers.

Plumbing Repairs

We assess leaks, blocked drains, taps, toilets and hot-water concerns, then agree the repair or replacement scope. Start with blocked drains, leak concerns and hot-water repairs, or the plumbing service overview and choose the service that matches the affected fitting or symptom.

Electrical Repairs

We arrange fault finding, safety-switch work, lighting, power points and smoke-alarm maintenance through appropriately licensed electrical tradespeople for the relevant work. The electrical service overview separates reported faults from planned installation.

Property Maintenance

For homes, rentals and strata-managed properties, we keep repair priorities, occupant contacts, access and approval instructions together. Use the property-management service for work orders and coordinated plumbing and electrical requests.

Request a repair

How a repair request moves forward

Clear details before work is arranged.

1. Tell us what you have noticed

Share the property suburb or address, the room or area affected, what you can see, hear or smell, and when the issue began. Photos can be helpful when they can be taken safely.

2. Include access and approval information

For managed properties, include the tenant or on-site contact, access notes, work-order reference and the person responsible for approvals. This helps us understand the practical context of the request.

3. Confirm scope and written quote

Our Perth team arranges an on-site assessment, identifies the fault or installation requirements and confirms the scope and written quote. We arrange the appropriately qualified trades for specialist or regulated work and confirm the responsible contractor and documentation before booking.

Questions customers often ask

Frequently asked questions

Know who is arranging the work

The public company details identify the business behind this website. They are separate from the documents relevant to a particular regulated job. Ask the Perth team privately for those documents before approving that scope. We do not publish individual staff details or treat a company registration as proof of every trade approval.

  • Ask the Perth team about your proposed work
  • Procurement and work-order information
Does an ABN record confirm the trade licence for my job?

No. ABN Lookup verifies the business registration record, not the scope or current status of an individual trade licence. Request the documentation relevant to the proposed plumbing or electrical work privately before approval.

Why does ABN Lookup show VIC when your office is in Perth?

ABN Lookup lists the registered company's main business location as VIC 3030. Our actual Perth office is at 140 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 6000. These are different records; the ABN entry does not verify the Perth office address or trade authorisation.

How is Ellis Services Group set up in Perth?

Ellis Services Group is part of the Ellis Group, with an independent Perth office and a dedicated Perth repair team serving homeowners, property managers and real-estate agencies across Perth.

Where can I verify the company details?

The Australian Business Register lists ELLIS SERVICES GROUP PTY LTD with ABN 96 645 821 745 and ACN 645 821 745. You can use the official ABR link above to view the current public record.

Can I request licensing or insurance evidence?

Yes. Ask for the relevant current documentation before work is arranged, particularly where the scope includes regulated or specialist work.

What repairs can I request?

You can request plumbing or electrical repairs, including blocked drains, leak concerns, hot-water problems, power faults, safety switches, lighting and power points. Describe the issue, property location and any access or approval details that are relevant.

Do I need to know the cause of the problem before I contact you?

No. Describe what you can observe, such as where the issue appears, when it started and whether there are any immediate safety concerns.

Can property managers and real-estate agencies contact Ellis Services Group?

Yes. Include the work-order reference, property address, occupant description, access contact and approval pathway where relevant.
